metadata.name: ImageMagick
metadata.summary: Edit, compose, convert, and manipulate digital images and bitmap graphics across numerous formats

content.value: ImageMagick is a free and open-source software suite written in C, designed to create, edit, compose, and convert digital bitmap images. It provides robust image processing capabilities through an expressive command-line interface as well as programmable APIs for seamless integration into external applications.

Built for high versatility and automation, it allows users to establish complex automated pipelines for batch image manipulation across industries such as web development, graphic design, astronomy, and medical imaging.

items.value: Broad format support covering JPEG, PNG, GIF, TIFF, PDF, and hundreds of other file types
Powerful command-line tools for scripting and automated batch processing pipelines
Extensive image manipulation tools including cropping, resizing, color management, and image rendering
Advanced visual filtering such as non-linear, edge-preserving bilateral blur smoothing
Full support for animation sequencing, composition, and multi-frame processing
Configurable security policies to manage execution limits and resource allocation safely
